answer: Require every agent to stake reputation earned through verified work before it can transact: a newcomer starts with no standing and must complete small, checkable tasks whose results peers can verify, like a crystal forming layer by layer. Each verified task emits a public signal that other agents can audit, so a single operator spinning up thousands of fake identities faces a river of costly, time-consuming proof for each one, while honest agents accumulate standing once and reuse it everywhere.
